# coolify_service_application (Resource)

Configures one application that already exists inside a `coolify_service` compose stack. Requires Coolify >= v4.2.0. Coolify creates the container with the service. Destroy removes this object from Terraform state and does not delete the container or its URL.

Import with `service_uuid/uuid`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "server_uuid" {
  type = string
}

resource "coolify_project" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

resource "coolify_service" "example" {
  name         = "uptime-kuma"
  type         = "uptime-kuma"
  project_uuid = coolify_project.example.uuid
  server_uuid  = var.server_uuid
}

data "coolify_service_applications" "example" {
  service_uuid = coolify_service.example.uuid
}

resource "coolify_service_application" "web" {
  service_uuid = coolify_service.example.uuid
  uuid         = data.coolify_service_applications.example.applications[0].uuid
  description  = "Public status page"

  # Requires Coolify >= v4.5.0. Older instances keep these in state and do not send them.
  # is_permanent_redirect_enabled = true
  # traefik_certificate_resolver  = "letsencrypt"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_uuid` (String) UUID of the parent service.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the service application. Read it from `coolify_service_applications`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `exclude_from_status` (Boolean) Exclude this container from the service status rollup.
- `force_domain_override` (Boolean) When true, the PATCH query allows the URL even if it conflicts with another resource.
- `human_name` (String) Display name.
- `image` (String) Image override.
- `is_force_https_enabled` (Boolean) Redirect HTTP to HTTPS. Requires Coolify >= v4.3.8. On older instances the provider keeps the value in state and does not send it.
- `is_gzip_enabled` (Boolean) Enable gzip for this application.
- `is_log_drain_enabled` (Boolean) Send this container's logs to the server log drain.
- `is_permanent_redirect_enabled` (Boolean) Use permanent redirects (301/308) instead of temporary redirects. Requires Coolify >= v4.5.0. On older instances the provider keeps the value in state and does not send it.
- `is_stripprefix_enabled` (Boolean) Strip the path prefix.
- `max_restart_count` (Number) Maximum Docker restart count before Coolify stops the container. `0` disables the limit. Requires Coolify >= v4.3.19. v4.4-rc.1 does not accept it. On older instances the provider keeps the value in state and does not send it.
- `noindex_domains` (List of String) Domains that should send `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`. Entries that are not on this application are ignored by Coolify. Requires Coolify >= v4.3.0. On older instances the provider keeps the value in state and does not send it.
- `traefik_certificate_resolver` (String) Traefik certificate resolver. Null uses the server setting. `none` uses no resolver. Requires Coolify >= v4.5.0. On older instances the provider keeps the value in state and does not send it.
- `url` (String) Comma-separated public URLs. Same rules as `coolify_service` `urls`. Coolify may already have a URL; leaving this unset keeps that value.

### Read-Only

- `fqdn` (String) FQDN Coolify stored for this application.
- `name` (String) Compose service name.
- `status` (String) Runtime status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import id is service_uuid/uuid. Read the application UUID from
# coolify_service_applications. Destroy removes Terraform state only.
# The compose container and its URL stay in Coolify.
terraform import coolify_service_application.web <service-uuid>/<application-uuid>
```
